description: This file defines the class VTEntityMethodTask, which extends VTTask and represents a task that executes a specific method on an entity within the vtiger CRM workflow framework. It includes functions for retrieving field names and performing the task by invoking a method through VTEntityMethodManager.

classes.name: VTEntityMethodTask
classes.description: A workflow task class that executes a specified method on an entity.

methods.name: getFieldNames
methods.description: Returns an array containing 'methodName', indicating the fields used by the task.

methods.name: doTask
methods.description: Executes the specified method on the entity data using VTEntityMethodManager.
